# vscode

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/vscode; do not edit. -->

VS Code from the vendor's official builds, its user settings file as a settings target, and optionally VS Code as the default editor.

The component lives in [`modules/components/vscode`](../../modules/components/vscode/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/vscode/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/vscode/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/vscode/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/vscode/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
